rites.name: Volintes
rites.text: A close-quarters strike used when distance, time, and supplies are scarce. Brutish swarm beasts and armored war-constructs rely on it most in tight combat.

rites.name: Grimurnak
rites.text: Grimurnak is a concept of the Syuzeth Weave, a thread-bound force the makers planted during the Seeding while the quieter powers of the Stellar Realm lay dormant. It is described as a patient, sleeping current that wakes only when a sealed seed is disturbed.

rites.name: Keloldade
rites.text: Keloldade is a concept of Syuzeth, the principle by which the makers plant the Weave across the young stars, letting quiet powers settle into sleep. It is remembered as the thread that binds groves and growing kingdoms during the Age of the first sovereign.

rites.name: Gairkouzhak
rites.text: Gairkouzhak is a concept of Syuzeth's Fall, the Sundering and the Shards, held in the Stellar Realm and the E4 Era of the Record. It stands for the moment worlds broke apart and the Pact was sworn in the Holy Age of flame, temples and orders.

rites.name: Colum
rites.text: A targeted aerial bombardment that cannot level structures but efficiently clears smaller foes. It can be acquired by a commander at a high tier of advancement for a substantial sum of trade tokens.

rites.name: Rarnanum
rites.text: A defensive strike is hurled from a high craft, blanketing a marked zone in crackling blue charge. Most foes caught in the blast freeze in place, while lingering fields only slow them down.

rites.name: Malles
rites.text: A flying craft drops a wide net of unaimed fiery charges across a chosen zone. The blasts shatter lesser structures and can destroy heavy armored war engines when they land directly.

rites.name: Telaurum
rites.text: A bombardment of incendiary canisters that drops from the sky and lays down a wall of flame, halting any enemies caught behind it. It is purchased by a commander using a bundle of supply tokens.

rites.name: Coriasor
rites.text: A ranked strike rains flaming incendiary cargo from high orbit onto a chosen ground zone. It is unlocked by reaching a fairly advanced tier of rank.

rites.name: Valontus
rites.text: A heavy orbital strike that rains down explosive shells from above. It is a larger version of a smaller shelling strike and is especially useful for scattering crowds.

rites.name: Coranteres
rites.text: A high-precision orbital bombardment called down from above, trading broad destructive force for tightly focused strikes. It serves as a lighter counterpart to a heavier version of the same weapon.

rites.name: Amorum
rites.text: A devastating aerial tactic that calls down three successive fiery fragment barrages onto a marked spot. Its wide blast zone and triple impact leave no soldier on foot alive.

rites.name: Teosintanum
rites.text: A defensive tactic in which a ship in high orbit fires a brief volley of obscuring shells onto a chosen zone, blinding anyone watching it below.

rites.name: Thornerath
rites.text: Thornerath is a concept that governs the branching of endings in Syuzeth, a thing of thorned flame that the orders of the Holy Age name as the sum of all unchosen futures. Its presence is felt in the temples as a pressure to choose, and it is said to shelve each rejected outcome in a silent library.

rites.name: Meravamari
rites.text: Meravamari is a concept woven into the Syuzeth of the Three Futures, where the ending forks and the Library shelves each branch. In the Holy Age of flame and temples, its adherents read the shelved outcomes as scripture and burn offerings to choose among them.
